motion.name: coordinate-easing
motion.purpose: Ease pointer coordinates; snap each axis when within 0.001. Does not blend source images.

motion.name: pose-hysteresis
motion.purpose: Retain the previous source pose when its squared spatial score is within 0.002 of the best candidate.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Select recorded poses without temporal smoothing when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

components.name: Instruction
components.description: Production cursor cue; coarse pointers receive the touch cue.
components.html: Move your cursorTouch and move
components.css: .ds-instruction { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #353b3c; margin: 28px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: .025em; text-align: center; user-select: none; } .ds-touch-hint { display: none; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-desktop-hint { display: none; } .ds-touch-hint { display: inline; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-instruction { margin-top: 24px; } }

components.name: Reload
components.description: Inline reload affordance shown only on portrait loading failure.
components.html: The portrait couldn’t load.
components.css: .ds-failure { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #353b3c; margin: 28px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: .025em; text-align: center; user-select: none; } .ds-reload { font: inherit; color: inherit; border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-reload:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #353b3c; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-failure { margin-top: 24px; } }

components.name: Diagnostic smoothing control
components.description: Observed development checkbox; disabled under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-control { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #353b3c; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: fit-content; padding: 4px 0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-control input { font: inherit; margin: 0; accent-color: #353b3c; width: 15px; height: 15px; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-control input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #353b3c; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-control { font-size: 11px; } }

narrative.overview: This document records the implemented experiment, whose presentation is pinned by the brief. A single centered portrait occupies a quiet neutral grey viewport, with one small instruction. It establishes no portfolio identity or broader component library.
keyCharacteristics: Full source composition, including hairstyle and shoulders.
Flat grey surface, generous whitespace, minimal system typography.
Viewer-relative interaction using recorded source poses.
dos: Do preserve the full source composition and responsive 16:9 sizing.
Do keep the normal experience centered, flat, and limited to its portrait and instruction.
Do retain source expression changes and disclose discrete pose transitions honestly.
donts: Don't add portfolio sections, decorative visual assets, or generated portrait imagery to this experiment.
Don't interpolate faces, crossfade poses, autoplay, or loop the source video.
Don't promote development diagnostics into the production interface.
